narrative.northStar: The Clear Desk (with Support Ember accents)
narrative.overview:
Enki is a modern, usable internal support messenger on a calm white plane. The Clear Desk leads: screens stay light, sparse, and scannable so Contacts, Agents, and Admins can finish a job without chrome noise. Enki Ember appears when it means action, selection, or “you” (primary buttons, selected chips, outgoing bubbles, avatar initials on Ember Mist). Ember Mist is the soft help wash — selected states and soft chips — not a second brand color fighting Graphite type.

Personality is friendly and direct: soft full pills, rounded cards, tactile press, no theatrical gradients. Depth is hybrid — hairline line borders at rest; soft card shadows for hub/inbox rows; stronger shadow only for overlays (reaction tray, attachment sheet). The thread composer is border-only at rest. This phase locks light chrome only; dark tokens exist in CSS for later but must not drive UI now.
keyCharacteristics: White Clear Desk surfaces; Graphite type; Enki Ember as the sparse action/help signal
Manrope for UI; JetBrains Mono for code-like fragments only
Soft rounded cards (~24px) and chat bubbles (~22px); pills are fully round
Hybrid elevation: border-first, soft card lift, stronger shadow only on overlays (composer is border-only at rest)
Role clarity via uppercase eyebrows (SUPPORT / AGENT / ADMIN), not per-role palettes
Ops hubs stay quiet: Graphite stats, neutral icon chips; amber for unassigned attention; Ember Mist for secondary CTAs

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Enki Ember occupies a small share of any screen. If ember is everywhere, the Clear Desk failed.

rules.name: The Light Chrome Rule
rules.body: Ship light appearance only this phase. Do not follow system dark mode for app chrome.

rules.name: The No Hex Escape Rule
rules.body: Palette colors come from Uniwind tokens or lib/tokens.ts hex for native headers/tabs/icons — never one-off bg-[#…] for palette roles.

rules.name: The Weight Face Rule
rules.body: Use font-medium / font-semibold / font-bold utilities so Manrope faces resolve correctly on native.

rules.name: The Role Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Role labels are uppercase text-xs labels in the greeting block (and settings active-role pill via hubEyebrow), never competing with the Enki header wordmark.

rules.name: The Safe Desk Rule
rules.body: Content stays inside safe areas; Android edge-to-edge + inset padding is mandatory — do not invent a second status-bar stack.

rules.name: The Hybrid Lift Rule
rules.body: Borders define resting structure; shadows appear for stacked cards and floating overlays — not as default decoration on every view.

rules.name: The Soft Continuity Rule
rules.body: Prefer the shared radius steps; do not mix sharp cards with pill everything on the same surface without reason.

dos: Do keep the Clear Desk: white Bg/Surface, Graphite type, Enki Ember as sparse signal.
Do use Ember Mist for soft selected/avatar/secondary moments.
Do put SUPPORT / AGENT / ADMIN in the greeting block and settings pill; brand the header as Enki only.
Do use hybrid elevation — line at rest (including composer), stronger shadow on overlays only.
Do keep Agent/Admin hub stats and tiles quiet (Graphite / neutral / amber attention).
Do honor reduced-motion paths for animated transitions.
Do add new colors to @theme and both @variant light and @variant dark when extending tokens.
Do use the type ramp utilities (text-xs … text-2xl); no arbitrary text-[Npx].
donts: Don't invent palette hex via arbitrary classes when a token exists.
Don't ship Messenger-dark chrome, nsave maroon, or red outgoing bubbles.
Don't build stories, case-status steppers, or Casewire branding.
Don't put role labels in the header wordmark or theme whole hubs per role color.
Don't show the agent avatar stack on the Contact hub.
Don't stack Enki Ember on unread time + badge + Offers avatar in the same row.
Don't put overlay-weight shadow on the resting composer.
Don't enable system dark mode for app chrome this phase.
Don't treat Offers as an ad SDK, checkout, or Instagram stories surface.
